title: Universal nodal model and its section-induced base map
statement: In any scheme universe, let $Z_u$ be the universe lift of $\mathbb Z$, and form the polynomial rings $A=Z_u[a]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring] and $P=A[u,v]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring], with $u,v$ indexed by $\{0,1\}$. Put $r=uv-a$ and $B=P/(r)$. Define the schemes $S_{\mathrm{nod}}=\operatorname{Spec}A$ and $Y_{\mathrm{nod}}=\operatorname{Spec}B$ [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and the structural morphism $\pi_{\mathrm{nod}}:Y_{\mathrm{nod}}\to S_{\mathrm{nod}}$ induced by the coefficient inclusion $A\to P\to B$. For each commutative ring $R$ in this universe, the canonical map $Z_u\to R$ is integer casting after the universe-lift equivalence. For every scheme $V$ in this universe and every $h\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, let $\varphi_h:A\to\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ be polynomial evaluation at $h$ with this coefficient map, and define $\beta_h:V\to S_{\mathrm{nod}}$ to be $V\to\operatorname{Spec}\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Spec}\varphi_h}\operatorname{Spec}A$. All rings, schemes and morphisms here are the explicit indicated constructions.
